lines.en: I drag along in my broken armour.
My crossbow is useless now.
I move along the palisade.
Something moves beneath the plates.
I head toward the camp.
I remember how to wear this armour.
My steps come unevenly.
I go around a campfire.
My helmet sits low.
I move with the assimilated band.
My boots are worn through.

lines.zh: 我走得不快,像在找什么
lines.en: I walk slowly, as if searching.

lines.zh: 我站着,头盔遮住半张脸
lines.en: I stand, my helmet hiding half my face.
My crossbow hangs at my hip.
I look down at my hands.
Old bloodstains remain on my armour.
I no longer shout slogans.
I touch my visor.
I turn my head slowly aside.
The camp's banner has fallen.

lines.zh: 我听见风里有别人的声音
lines.en: I hear another's voice in the wind.
I do not know who commands me now.
You do not dress like one of us.
I look at you through my visor.
You are standing far too close.

lines.zh: 我的手已经不在弩上了
lines.en: My hand is no longer on the crossbow.

lines.zh: 我袖口里还别着半截弩箭。
lines.en: Half a crossbow bolt is still tucked in my cuff.
I slowly push my helmet up.

lines.zh: 我的甲片缝里长出肉芽。
lines.en: Fleshy sprouts push through my armor seams.
I do not want that kind of fight again.
But my body disagrees.

lines.zh: 你看着我的时候,我在看你的手
lines.en: While you look at me, I watch your hands.
Another dent in my armour.
I step back and steady.
That one got through.
I grit my teeth and stay silent.
My visor went askew.

lines.zh: 我按着腰，弩还挂在手上。
lines.en: I press my side, crossbow still in hand.

lines.zh: 血从甲缝里流出来，是黑的。
lines.en: Blood seeps from the armor seams, black.
Blood comes through the seams.
I do not want to fall again.
Not one more time.
I no longer collect such things.
But this does not smell bad.
I reach out, stiffly.
I take it from you.
My hand is shaking.
This is not worth a raid.

lines.zh: 我以前会连人一起带走
lines.en: I used to take the person too.
Now I only take this.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里发出咯咯的响声。
lines.en: A gurgling sound rises in my throat.
This one came free.
My pauldron knocks you back.
I turn half a step to shed it.
The plates give a dull knock.
I pull back and steady.
Your whole body crowds me.
I do not want to fight at close range again.
You stepped on my crossbow.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起了战场
lines.en: That reminded me of the field.
Do not shove me with your hands.
Let me past, please.
I cannot take this armour off.

lines.zh: 里面已经不是原来的样子
lines.en: What is inside is no longer what it was.
You may stand on this side.
I have raised my visor.
Take a look for yourself.

lines.zh: 我不指望你说什么好话
lines.en: I do not expect kind words.
We sit together.
The campfire went out long ago.
This counts as company too.
Do not wander off.
I bend and pick it up.
This can still serve.

lines.zh: 我捡起掉落的弩箭，塞回袋里。
lines.en: I pick up the fallen bolt and stuff it in my pouch.
This is not mine.
But no one wants it now.
I weigh it in my hand.
It is rather old.
I tuck it into my armour.
This used to be spoils.
Now it is only iron.
I lowered the crossbow.
But I turned toward you anyway.
This body remembers how to fight.
I remember how to aim.
Stand still for now.
I would rather not, really.

lines.zh: 我的弩已经对准你的胸口。
lines.en: My crossbow is already aimed at your chest.
No one in camp commands me.
So I decide myself.

lines.zh: 你听见弩弦的声音了吗
lines.en: Did you hear the crossbow string?
I did not draw it.
The body moved on its own.
Then I will go first.
Retreating will not help.
I circle in from the palisade side.

lines.zh: 我把视线压在面罩后面
lines.en: I keep my gaze behind the visor.
You go left; I follow slowly.

lines.zh: 我记得从侧面绕的打法
lines.en: I remember flanking tactics.
My armour is heavy, but the steps are familiar.
I am looking for a wall to brace against.
The view here is poor.
You have gone behind the palisade.
That will not stop a bolt.
An assimilated hand cannot hold a crossbow.
I cannot hold these hands back.
I level my crossbow and quicken my pace.
I can see you clearly now.
I level the crossbow.
This shot will be true.

lines.zh: 我的脚步和从前一样稳
lines.en: My steps are as steady as they once were.

lines.zh: 栅栏的影子把我藏了一半
lines.en: The palisade's shadow hides half of me.
I count the posts of the palisade.

lines.zh: 我压着步子,不让它冲太快
lines.en: I hold my pace so it will not rush.
The crossbow string sounded.
That bolt went out reluctantly.
I slam in after it.
My armour pins you down.
I strike down with my elbow.
You went back two steps.
My crossbow fell to the ground.
Then I use my claws.
That one felt like me.
I pull back and take two breaths.
I should not be this practised.
This body remembers.
I only follow the body.
That is enough.
My claws scrape past my own armour.

lines.zh: 这一下带着旧日的力气
lines.en: This blow carries an old strength.
I step out from behind the palisade.
Rags still hang from my broken armour.
My crossbow still hangs at my waist.
There is no one left in the camp.
I step over a fallen banner.

lines.zh: 我的弩挂在腰上,不上弦
lines.en: My crossbow hangs unstrung at my hip.

lines.zh: 我记得这里原来的样子
lines.en: I remember how this place used to look.
The wind lifts the ash.
I look toward where the people are.

lines.zh: 这身甲还在,人不太完整
lines.en: The armour is still here; the man is not.
Is anyone still here?

lines.zh: 我听见自己的声音变了
lines.en: I hear that my voice has changed.
My armour grows hot.
I tumble down from a height.
Water enters around my visor.

lines.zh: 冲击把我掀翻在栅栏边
lines.en: The blast throws me against the palisade.

lines.zh: 箭杆震得我整条手臂发麻。
lines.en: The shaft's shock numbs my whole arm.
That force pierced the armour.
The camp has no rations left.
Lightning runs along my armour.

lines.zh: 我张开手，什么也抓不住。
lines.en: I spread my hands and catch nothing.
